name: alert-triangle
description: An open warning triangle with a compact exclamation.
useCase: Flag a condition that needs attention alongside an explanation.
misuse: Do not imply physical safety certification or use color as the only warning.

16.reason: The triangle extends above the circular keyline and its wide base sits slightly high; this compensates for the bottom-heavy outline. Text master: 1.5px construction.

24.reason: The triangle extends above the circular keyline and its wide base sits slightly high; this compensates for the bottom-heavy outline. Interface master: 1.75px construction.
